page.overview:
Who is Alyxian?

, dubbed the Apotheon, was a mortal champion blessed by three of the Prime Deities in the Calamity.

Alyxian was born a human with olive skin and curly brown hair. As a child, he was dirty and untidy in appearance; as a teenage hunter he was slender. He carried a sword as a young man and apparently for much of the Calamity, and as an adult he was granted the Jewel of Three Prayers, initially a golden amulet on a golden chain.

Late in the Calamity he had soft features worn by pain. Then, and in visions long afterward, Alyxian is often shown with a spear, leather armor, and a red cape, and he appears with items representing his connection to the three deities who gave him their blessings. He carries a shield emblazoned with the icon of Sehanine (a crescent moon strung like a bow), a brooch with the golden profile of Avandra, and a dagger in a sheath bearing the crested moons of Corellon's symbol. Just before his final confrontation with the Ruiner, he wielded a spear, and he glowed with a silver-and-green aura representing the blessings of Sehanine and Corellon, and the golden light of Avandra's power flared as he blocked the Ruiner's spear. In visions, he may still appear with a tattered red cape over leather armor, and carrying a shield.

After centuries in the Netherdeep, Alyxian's appearance changes depending on his form. As Alyxian the Tormented, he is a huge, many-eyed monster with a thick, pale white hide pierced and scarred by many blades; it has dozens of arms, six of them capable of grappling enemies. As Alyxian the Callous, he has an angelic form with gleaming feathers and a cold, expressionless face; he is armored in half plate and surrounded by a halo of spears, and he wields a brilliant radiant spear. As Alyxian the Dispossessed, he is a hunched, weary old human man with gray hair, again wearing leather armor and carrying a shield, spear, and magic dagger. When he is redeemed, he maintains much the same appearance, but there is no dagger.
